'''star532 You have how many star destoryers!!-revised''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[star532]]
* '''Published:''' 18 January 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Theme/Fun

== Introduction ==

Check this out!  Any more suggestions would be appreciated!!!   PLZ-SOME FEEDBACK!  (and yes, i have considered using virtual cards, but the people I play with won't play with them :()
